book.title: LUK Kamambuno Wakai Luk Muno Boglkwa

content: Kongun yomba sutno kinde moglkwa kamo dibogl dungwa

Yesus disaipelma wagle ditongwa, “Yagl ta moglkwa taragl merkinde ake nongwa, ana ye kongunmo yomba ta sugl moglko, ana yomba eremogl bona nemyagl diteingwa, ‘Ene bonan sugl moglkwa yagle guagua orme dingwa.’

Yegl dingo, ye kongun yomba agle di yungugl ende ana krapoglkwa, ‘Ene sraglmere etngo na ka i dingo pirye? Ene monina kongunmo etnga mere pepa muno bogl yenatnga inaro, sraglpre, ene na konguna sugl yomba ta mogl paikratnga.’

“Ana kongun sugl yomba yene poglodi prukwa, ‘Na erme sragl eragle? Na yombana kande konguna mina na simenda endungwa. Na yombura ta kuno eran makan waknaglka mere manga, te na taragl yana dinaglka i angai goglka.
Na erme sragl eraglmere i pirka, na konguna i yagl kande na sendinan, ana yomba yungu kei panaglmara na di yungugl endinaglkwa.’
“Yeglpre ye eremogl yombamo kande moni kur tongwa yomba i prapra aglendi isuna ende ana komuno kana kur tongwa yagle ikra diprukwa, ‘Ene moni kur sramuna na yombana kande mina inendi?’
“Ana ye di ikine endungwa, ‘Olip nuglo dram 100.’ “Ana kongun yomba kande di ye tongwa, ‘Ene kur inga pepa indre ana tambre amedi mogltre 50 boglo.’
“Ana mokomugl ungwa yagle ikra krapogl prukwa, ‘Ene kur sramuna inendi?’ “Ye di ikine endungwa, ‘Plawa bek 1,000.’ “Ana ye ditongwa, ‘Kur inga pepa indre bogl i 800 endo.’

“Taragl nemyagl eremogl kongun sugl yomba guagua orkwa ikra dembiye sungwa. Sraglpre, ye taragl orkwa i yomba nomano wakai pangwa mereyegl. Ana makan yomba koglkoglo pirpogl sindre nomano wakai pangwa mere kongun kanekane ere yomba tendre, ana yomba du-wakai ambuglange mina meglkwa i engrikwa.
Ana na ene diteinga, makandle moni ya bona gana yomba tenaglkwa i enene yei ninamnedi pre erikwa, taragl yegl dundinambuka enge, ene ende wu aimande kamun meglmara yungugl wo dinaglkwa.

“Yomba ta taragl kembra mina bonma ere sugl wakai morambuka, ye taragl merkinde akiye bonma ere sugl wakai morambuka, te yomba ta taragl kembra mina bonma erekre sugl wakai moglkran, ye taragl kande ama bonma erekre sugl wakai moglkrambuka.
Yeglpre, ene makandle minge moni i sugl wakai moglkrimbi, ana ira eremogl ene taragl kaima tendre pra sugl moraglmedi pirambe?
Ba ene yomba ta taraglmo bonma ere sugl wakai moglkitn ana enene taratn i yomba ira tenambe?

“Kongun yomba suwarata yagl kande suwo konguno erekrambuka, ye ta kan wakai yei, ana ta ekriye bogl tenambuka. Mo ta kamo pinande ere ana ta kamo sendinambuka. Ene eremogl God kongunmo ya minge moni kongun i-suwara ende erekraglkwa.”
God kingdomo pre Yesus di Parisi wagle tongwa
Parisi wagle ka prapra dungwa i pirtre ana Yesus bakagl teingwa, sraglpre ye minge moni bumbuno geglkwa.

Yesus di Parisi wagle tongwa, “Ene yomba tau ongumutno wagle enene yomba du-wakai meglkwa mere erikwa, ba God ene nomano suna kangwa. Yeglpre, yomba nomano mina pirkwa taragl pond pai mitna endungwa, i God ongumuglo mina wu taragl yoko ongwa.

“Moses lomo ya propet kanno dipene ende wu Jon Baptais moglkwa enge igle ungo, ana God kingdomo ka wakai i dipene ende teingo, ana yomba prapra pirtre yene yombuglo ere ende kingdom suna enamunedi erikwa.
Ba kamun kua ya makan wau borambrika, ba God lomo pangwa i kembra suwara ta wau boglkrambuka.
“Yagl ta embiye sende ambu kor ta inan, ye ambu kunogl gundungwa, ana yagl ta eremogl yagl embiye okuwo sendungwa ikra inan, ye ambu kunogl gundungwa.
Yagl taragl merkinde paitongwa ya Lasarus
“Yagl ta moglkwa ye taragl merkinde paitongwa, kungugl gagl topo kande boglkwa ende ana yungu wakaile engenge moglpai orkwa.
Ye konbaunamo dra mina igle, kiuglgiunde yagl ta pai mogl-mogl orkwa. Ye kangiye Lasarus, nangiye mina num de poriya sungwa.
Ana ye kaiya mokna diurkwa yange bogl atne sungwa i ninagledi prukwa, te agl undre nangiye num domara i-pene dingwa.
“Yaglmo kiuglgiunde ikra goglko ana angelo boglo ere yendpi Abraham moglmara endingo miurka. Taragl merkinde ake-nongwa yagle ikra ombugl goglko ana maugl singwa.
Ye geglkwa dumo suna mogl giu pond indre ana kan mitna ende kango Abraham eglkekuri moglko te Lasarus ombugl Abraham bogl miurka.

Yeglpre, ye agle dungwa, ‘Nina Abraham, na mitna gogl nartre, ana Lasarus di endimin ye ongo mongo nigl mina simbai iyu na drambina simbanan bi yenambuka. Sraglpre, na donga mina suna mogl giu pond goglka.’
“Ba Abraham di ikine endungwa, ‘Wana, ene kor-mogl panga enge, taragl wakai prapra ingra i pitno, te Lasarus taragl kinde prapra yungura, ba ye erme yawagle gun pond yongwa, te ene giu pond gotnga.

Ana taragl ta ama yegl, drugl kogl kande no mina ya ene mina suna pangwa, yeglpre eglya mogl ende koglo ene motnara enaglkwa kuno erekrukwa, te ene motnara ende no mounara ya unaglkwa kuno erekrukwa.’
“Taragl merkinde paitongwa yagle ikra dungwa, ‘Nina, yegl eran na ene yana dinga, Lasarus di nina yungumo mina endo.
Sraglpre na angrima wagle 5 meglkwa, Lasarus di endimin pi ka giglendi ditenan, ye mambunono kinde akedu ende ana giu angai eglya ukraglkwa.’
“Ana Abraham di ikine endungwa, ‘Ene angitnma wagle eremogl ana Moses ya propet wagle kanno dingwa i ake meglkwa ana ene kanwinge etn ye ka dingwa i angitnma wagle piryondo.’
“Taragl merkinde paitongwa yagle di ikine endungwa, ‘Taman, Nina Abraham, yomba goglkwa andigltre ende ye meglmara enan ana ye pra nomano yake tenaglkwa.’
“Ba Abraham ditongwa, ‘Ye eremogl Moses ya propet wagle kanno pirkrimbi ana yomba goglkwa ta andigl ukor enan ye ama nomano ta yake tekraglkwa.’”

footnotes.text: Ka i kamo mongo wu nongugl kaima pikrukwa. Erme pirpogl singwa yomba tau ye, Yesus ka yegl dumedi pirkwa, “Nono moni ya bona gana ake nomga i yomba taragl doko meglkwa i tenamga ana okuwo ye bogl heven suna gun yei moramga.”
